title: ग्वालिनी
description: From the collection प्रसिद्ध प्रबन्धसङ्ग्रह. Transcribed from the identified Sahitya Ras source edition. Source wording and literary structure retained; not checked against printed pages. Nepali translation by Laxmi Prasad Devkota; original author credit is retained in the text: सर टमस ओभर्बरी (१५८१–१६१३).

rights.basis: Author died 1959; Nepal's Copyright Act 2059 grants life + 50 years, expiring 2009.
